summary: Interactions API: the presence_penalty and frequency_penalty generation options and the cached_content request/response field are removed (no longer supported)
The Interactions namespace no longer exports the Arguments type (URL context call arguments; use URLContextCallArguments) or the RetrievalType type

models.generateImages() and models.editImage() (Imagen) and models.generateVideos() called with prompt/image/video arguments now log deprecation warnings (removal planned for a future major; use generateContent with image models, or the source argument)
HttpOptions.timeout now bounds each HTTP attempt (each retry gets a fresh deadline) instead of the whole call
response_modalities on Interactions create params (CreateModelInteraction/CreateAgentInteraction) and on Interaction is marked @deprecated
The StreamMetadata type and the metadata (total_usage) field are removed from Interactions stream events (interaction.created/completed, status updates, step start/stop)
The deprecated Interactions Turn and TurnContent types are removed from the exported types
The call_id field is removed from the Interactions FunctionResultDelta stream type
The Interactions environment network Allowlist type changes from an object { allowlist?: AllowlistEntry[] } to AllowlistEntry[] | 'disabled'

On Node, requests made without an explicit timeout are no longer cut off by undici's default headers/body timeouts (the SDK's default HTTP timeouts are raised so long-running calls are not killed client-side)
